user.title: Energydash
user.description: Energydash is added to the sidebar. There you choose your electricity price and meters, and add your devices.

reconfigure.description: Prices and meters are in the Energydash panel, under Settings. Here you can clear calculated data or start completely fresh.

missing_entity.description: The entity {entity_id} does not exist (anymore). Choose another source in Energydash or restore the entity.

recalculate.description: Replace calculated results by a recalculation over the recorder history (usually 10 days).

reset.description: Clear calculated data, or also remove all devices.
